AnswerFrame.description: The host answers one call. id is null when the call carried no usable id.

CallFrame.description: A member calls one command of the host. args defaults to {} when absent. computer names the computer the member writes from.

EventFrame.description: An event the host published, forwarded inside one more event key. epoch and seq place it in the host's replay ring of the space.

epoch.description: Drawn once per hosting run of the space, and again when the host loses events.

seq.description: 1 for the first frame of the epoch, one more for each next frame.

token.description: Present only on a frame replayed for a ResumeCallFrame: the token of that call. A member that did not send it drops the frame.

ResumeAnswerFrame.description: The answer to a ResumeCallFrame, sent after the replayed event frames. The relay hands it to every member: only the one that sent token takes it.

ResumeCallFrame.description: A call frame asking the host to replay every frame of epoch above since. The host answers it itself.

description: One text frame of the member socket. member-socket.md tells how they are exchanged.
